facts.text: Get up, Cage. It's day one again. We have a battle to fix, and breakfast first.
facts.why: Not found among Rita's lines on the quote page. Her real line is 'Come find me when you wake up!' This one is printed in quote marks.
facts.fix: Come find me when you wake up!

fix_note.text: Come find me when you wake up!

facts.why: Cage is demoted to Private before he is sent to Heathrow, so on the duffel bag tag at Heathrow he is Private Cage, not Major.
facts.full: Duffel Bag Tag / Major Cage / Report at dawn. Again.

vibe.verdict: A good British base mess with the loop jokes and army tea, but it is a stock canteen layout and the signed note is invented.
